title: Kairos CliReport (kairos list|next --json)
description: Output of the reference CLI with --json. Success: command/version/tz/from/to/results/coverage/warnings. Failure (exit code 1): command/version/error. Points are instants on the base time axis (epoch ms = identity); dates are their civil labels in the report's tz and correspond one-to-one to points. Published with kairos-lang 1.0.6 (1.0 addendum 23); later revisions are backward compatible. 1.0.9 (addendum 26) adds results[].uid.

tz.description: the tz the labels and [from, to) are read in (--tz, else the machine tz). A premise tz: in scope governs evaluation

from.description: evaluation range [from, to): civil day start in tz

to.description: exclusive end. For next: the day after the last found firing (or the horizon end)

found.description: next only: firings actually found (< requested means exit code 2)

results.description: one entry per body expression, in document order

coverage.description: coverage summary (ADR-37 decision 7 (b)): every data source the evaluation consulted, not clipped to [from, to)

warnings.description: implementation warnings (horizon-clip, window-clip, I5 ...); also written to stderr

source.description: the body expression as written (trimmed; multi-line pipes keep their newlines)

line.description: 1-based line of the expression's first token. Needed to tell apart identical expressions under different preambles

uid.description: fingerprint of the expression (1.0.9, addendum 26): FNV-1a 64 of (index in results, source, tz) as 12 hex digits — identical to the UID of the expression's recurring VEVENT in --ics-series. In the one-event-per-point form (--ics) each point's UID is this value with '-series@' replaced by '-<ms>@' (ms = the point), and each annotation event's with '-ann-<fromMs>-<toMs>@'. A fingerprint, not a durable identity: editing the expression text, its order in the file, or tz yields a different value — keep your own record id and use uid to tell whether the definition is the same

dates.description: civil labels of the points in tz: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.SSS]]; seconds and milliseconds appear only when non-zero; when the wall-clock time occurs twice (DST overlap) the UTC offset ±HH:MM is appended to both occurrences, so labels are unique and correspond one-to-one to points. Same length and order as points

points.description: epoch milliseconds, strictly ascending, within [from, to). The identity of each point ('judgement is external': intersect these with your own data)

stages.description: only with --explain: the pipe's head and each stage, with the point count after it (the lightweight explain)

source.description: premise.binding (or the binding name) whose data coverage the interval depends on

asof.description: version identifier of the data (compared by identity only)
version identifier of the data (compared by identity only); '(宣言 asof … と不一致)' is appended when it differs from the premise's asof:

concluded.description: true when the covering is open-ended (claims completeness forever)

runwayDays.description: days from `to` to the end of the coverage (negative when already past); null when concluded

stage.description: the head expression or the stage as written (names, numbers and strings expanded; lambdas shown as λ)

count.description: points within [from, to) after this stage

windows.description: windowed streams only: windows intersecting [from, to)

annotations.description: out-of-coverage intervals within [from, to) after this stage

kind.description: usage: arguments, files, or the --supply JSON itself; supply: the supply contract (external) was violated; static: the definition (lexical, syntactic, static or evaluation error)
